sloka: सबलो वा मुनिश्रेष्ठ सहितो वा मम आत्मजैः ।कथम् अपि अमर प्रख्यम् संग्रामाणाम् अकोविदम् ॥१-२०-२४॥
transliteration: sabalo vā muniśreṣṭha sahito vā mama ātmajaiḥ ।katham api amara prakhyam saṁgrāmāṇām akovidam ॥1-20-24॥

translations.english: O brahman although my son resembles the celestials he is not experienced in warfare. On no account shall I spare him.
